results.content: # Wall Street week ahead: Reports on consumer confidence and inflation on tap. NEW YORK (AP) — Wall Street will get key updates next week on closely-watched measures for consumer confidence and inflation. Wall Street expects the report to show that confidence in the U.S. economy fell again in August after slipping in July. Consumer confidence has been weak most of the year as inflation remains stubbornly high. It has also raised costs for shipping a wide range of products, from groceries to clothing.
